deduplicated_high_findings.title: `as McpTransport` cast bypasses runtime validation of union type
deduplicated_high_findings.description: normalizeServiceConfigPayload accepts any string for transport; updateServiceConfig casts with `as McpTransport` without validating against union members. Invalid values silently pass through.
deduplicated_high_findings.suggestion: Add runtime validation in normalizeServiceConfigPayload: check against valid transports list, throw or default to 'streamable-http'.

deduplicated_high_findings.title: EngineInternals `as unknown as` pattern breaks encapsulation
deduplicated_high_findings.description: EngineInternals type mirrors protected fields; `as unknown as EngineInternals` bypasses TypeScript's protected access enforcement. Field renames in SequentialThinking will silently break at runtime.
deduplicated_high_findings.suggestion: Add public accessor methods to SequentialThinking for needed data. Remove EngineInternals type.

deduplicated_high_findings.title: GatewayDeps violates Interface Segregation Principle (15+ methods)
deduplicated_high_findings.description: Fat interface forces every consumer to depend on methods it doesn't use. Each endpoint only needs 3-5 methods but must implement all 15+.
deduplicated_high_findings.suggestion: Split into focused sub-interfaces: HealthEngineAccess, RuntimeStateAccess, ServiceRegistryAccess, ObservabilityAccess, MetricsAccess, ConfigAccess.

deduplicated_high_findings.title: 500 error responses expose internal error details to clients
deduplicated_high_findings.description: Raw Error.message sent in JSON response body. Can leak file paths, DB connection strings, stack traces.
deduplicated_high_findings.suggestion: Log full error server-side; send generic 'Internal server error' to client.

deduplicated_high_findings.title: validateSchemaVersion: `startsWith('1.')` too permissive + null handling
deduplicated_high_findings.description: '). `startsWith('1.')` allows '1.<injected>' through validation. Version string interpolated in error messages enables log injection.
deduplicated_high_findings.suggestion: Use `if (raw == null) return;` for null guard. Use strict regex `/^1\.\d+(\.\d+)?$/` for version check.

deduplicated_high_findings.title: DEFAULT_GATEWAY_* constants declared but never referenced; hardcoded values remain inline
deduplicated_high_findings.description: Three extracted constants (lines 7-9) are dead code. The same hardcoded values appear inline 6+ times. Also duplicated across mcp/config.ts.
deduplicated_high_findings.suggestion: Replace all inline values with constant references, or remove dead constants. Deduplicate across modules via shared gateway-constants module.

deduplicated_high_findings.title: Bi-directional dependency between container and mcp creates circular import risk
deduplicated_high_findings.description: container imports from 6 mcp modules; mcp imports from container. Layer violation: infrastructure depends on presentation.
deduplicated_high_findings.suggestion: Move control-plane to a dedicated composition-root module above both container and mcp.

deduplicated_high_findings.title: GatewayDeps mixes immutable DI with mutable runtime state
deduplicated_high_findings.description: healthCheck() directly mutates runtimeLastProbeAt, runtimeReconnectAttempts, runtimeLastError on the deps object.
deduplicated_high_findings.suggestion: Extract mutable state into dedicated GatewayRuntimeTracker class with explicit state-recording methods.

deduplicated_high_findings.title: Inconsistent logger naming: _log vs log across same change set
deduplicated_high_findings.description: graph-engine.ts uses `log`; 6 other changed files use `_log`. No documented convention. 22 files codebase-wide use `log`, 42+ use `_log`.
deduplicated_high_findings.suggestion: Adopt one convention, document in spec entry, rename consistently.

deduplicated_high_findings.title: Agents use dual logging (this.logActivity + _log.warn) for same purpose
deduplicated_high_findings.description: Public methods use this.logActivity(); private methods use _log.warn. logActivity loses structured metadata { detail: e }.
deduplicated_high_findings.suggestion: Extend logActivity to accept optional metadata, then standardize all agent catch blocks on this.logActivity.
